title: Preference Learning and Demand Forecast
eligible_reason: Online choice experiment that randomizes price and (stated) availability probability for a virtual item; cross-sectional logit/OLS of purchase and think time on price and probability, then a structural preference-learning model. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: reduced_form_analysis.do (Tables 1-6): logit Purchase price by probability arm; logit/reg Purchase on price_dm, prob_dm, their interaction, log_diamond, VIP; reg think_time / log_thinktime / exam_think on prob_dm, price_dm; robust SE. estimation.m and extrapolation_compare.m (MATLAB) for the structural model (Tables 7-9).
data_files_note: result_all.xlsx: 5,420 user-level rows from the choice experiment (uid, price1, prob1, purchase, diamond, VIP, timing, survey answers).
data_provenance_note: Experiment data as used in the do-file; no masking stated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
